_readme: These are REAL characterisation factors, not proxies. They cover exactly the elementary
flows that appear DIRECTLY in the PEFDPP case study foreground graph (see
case-study/lcidatasets/secondary/biosphere.ttl). The graph identifies each elementary flow
by its EF 3.1 UUID, so the join between inventory and characterisation is machine-made:
no name matching, no spreadsheet lookup, no human in the loop.
Where a factor is not bundled, the engine reports the flow as UNCHARACTERISED rather than
substituting a guess. Coverage is reported per impact category so a reader can see exactly
how much of each indicator is actually computed.
The full EF 3.1 factor set is distributed by the JRC European Platform on LCA:

meta.source: JRC European Platform on LCA — EF 3.1 reference package
meta.coverage_note: Subset covering the elementary flows present in the case study foreground.

impact_categories.label: Climate change
impact_categories.regulation_note: The indicator required by Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 Article 7 for the battery carbon footprint declaration.

08a91e70-3ddc-11dd-923d-0050c2490048.label: carbon dioxide (fossil)
08a91e70-3ddc-11dd-923d-0050c2490048.note: Definitional: fossil CO2 is the reference substance for GWP100.

f79d0f8f-2b0e-49cb-bed0-b1ea0fbd8625.label: nitrogen oxides
f79d0f8f-2b0e-49cb-bed0-b1ea0fbd8625.note: EF 3.1 factors for NOx as NO2.

fe0acd60-3ddc-11dd-a207-0050c2490048.label: sulfur oxides
fe0acd60-3ddc-11dd-a207-0050c2490048.note: EF 3.1 factors for SOx as SO2.

08a91e70-3ddc-11dd-9293-0050c2490048.label: particles (PM2.5)
08a91e70-3ddc-11dd-9293-0050c2490048.note: EF 3.1 PM2.5 factor; the reference substance for the particulate matter indicator.

08a91e70-3ddc-11dd-91be-0050c2490048.label: particles (PM10)
08a91e70-3ddc-11dd-91be-0050c2490048.note: EF 3.1 PM10 factor (coarse fraction, lower intake fraction than PM2.5).

e2fb04b0-6555-11dd-ad8b-0800200c9a66.label: oxygen
e2fb04b0-6555-11dd-ad8b-0800200c9a66.note: Inert atmospheric gas; no characterisation factor in any EF 3.1 category. Zero by definition, not by omission.

08a91e70-3ddc-11dd-9804-0050c2490048.label: hydrogen fluoride
08a91e70-3ddc-11dd-9804-0050c2490048.note: HF is characterised in EF 3.1 (acidification, human toxicity), but the factor is not bundled here. The engine reports this flow as uncharacterised rather than guessing. Load the full EF 3.1 reference package to close this gap.

fe0acd60-3ddc-11dd-a784-0050c2490048.label: 1-methyl-2-pyrrolidone
fe0acd60-3ddc-11dd-a784-0050c2490048.note: NMP emission to air. Characterised in EF 3.1 toxicity and photochemical ozone categories; factor not bundled here.
